MTU 1223 (Varsha) (MTU 1081 / MTU 1064) - rice variety factsheet.
Product profile: MTU 1223 (Varsha), a high-yielding, late-maturing variety with medium-slender grains, was developed through pedigree breeding by ANGRAU University (Maruteru) in 2019. Specifically recommended for rainfed shallow lowland ecologies in Odisha and Bihar, this variety matures in about 150 days and can yield an average of 6 tons per hectare. MTU 1223 exhibits moderate tolerance to bacterial leaf blight, leaf blast, neck blast, and stem borer, enhancing its resilience to common pests and diseases.
Priority market segment: TLaMF-R/I.
Planting method and ecosystem suitability (PTR = puddled transplanted rice, DSR = direct seeded rice): PTR: Recommended; DSR: Not Recommended; Irrigated Lowland: Not Recommended; Rainfed Lowland: Recommended; Upland: Not Recommended.

MTU 1223 (Varsha) - key strengths, considerations and positioning.
Key strengths: Good yield; Medium height; sturdy stem; Profuse tillering and compact panicles; Resistant to blast and BLB; Low shattering of grains (<2%); Highly translucent kernels with high head rice recovery of 64%.
Considerations: Late maturity.
Positioning (variety replaced / companion, by ecosystem): Replace - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: Pooja; Upland: None. Companion - Irrigated Lowland: None; Rainfed Lowland: CR Dhan 508; Upland: None.

MTU 1223 (Varsha) - grain yield, agronomic traits and grain shape (HRR = head rice recovery; grain shape SB = short bold, MS = medium slender, SM = short medium, LB = long bold, MB = medium bold).
MTU 1223 (Varsha) -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 6000-6500; % Adv: 8; Maturity (days): 145-150; Plant height (cm): 115-120; Lodging: Tolerant; HRR %: 64; 1000-grain wt (g): 18; Grain shape: MS.
Pooja -> Grain yield (kg/ha): 5000-6000; Maturity (days): 150-155; Plant height (cm): 90-95; Lodging: Susceptible; HRR %: 54; 1000-grain wt (g): 20; Grain shape: MS.

MTU 1223 (Varsha) - biotic and abiotic stress reaction (disease and pest tolerance; BPH = brown plant hopper, RTV = rice tungro virus).
MTU 1223 (Varsha) -> Leaf blast: Tolerant; Leaf blight: Tolerant; Sheath blight: Tolerant; BPH: Tolerant.
Pooja -> Leaf blast: Tolerant; Leaf blight: Susceptible; Sheath blight: Susceptible; BPH: Susceptible.

MTU 1223 (Varsha) - producibility and recommendation.
Producibility: MTU 1223 (Varsha) = 2400 Kgs./acre.
Recommendation: Released for cultivation in Bihar and Odisha.
